title: Concept: Served source map embeds the original source code
description: A source map with sourcesContent embeds the original files, comments and internal URLs next to the minified build. Serving it hands the application source to anyone who opens developer tools, which removes the only real benefit of minifying and often discloses endpoints that never appear in the shipped bundle.
applicability: Responses that serve JavaScript, CSS or any compiled asset together with its source map.
risk: The caller reads the original source, its comments and any internal hosts or feature flags named there, which supports targeted exploitation and endpoint discovery.
